q: This card is linked to a Digimon.
If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?

a: Linking a card isn't the same  as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.
q: Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card.
Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?

Effect: While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Until your turn ends, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend. Then, add this card to the hand.
[Main] You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
Link Condition: ＜Link＞ Lv. 3 or higher: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
Link Effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
